_comment: Reviewed prose stored as data — tier 2 of the three-tier rule in sources/scope.md ('No free-generated text on the site'). Each block carries a status: every tier-2 text passes through one review before flipping to 'approved', with the review date recorded in 'reviewed'; 'final' marks the masthead pair George signed off as-is. Slots in {braces} are filled at build time from gate-checked objects — never hardcoded here. The site-wide blocks resolve their slots against the site summary object (data/summaries/site.json) in web/lib/sitetext.ts; 'ego_notes' resolves its slots against the computed ego view in sources/build_ego_views.py, which bakes the rendered sentence into data/graph/ego/<file>.json.

masthead.tagline: EU legislation, decoded into data: each measure, every sector it affects, every supply chain it reaches.
masthead.subline: The intelligence layer between EU legislation and the real economy.

perimeter.template: PolicyFocus decodes EU legislation into data. Each act is read provision by provision into individual measures: obligations, prohibitions, incentives, and rights, every one carrying the verbatim source text and a link to the official version. Measures are mapped to sectors in two ways: sectors an act names directly, and sectors it reaches through supply chains, regulatory dependencies, or procurement channels, with supply-chain reach computed from Eurostat input-output data. The measures are then aggregated per sector, so each sector page shows its full position across all legislation on the platform: what binds it directly, what reaches it indirectly, and through which channel. The platform currently holds {measures_count} measures from {acts_count} legislative acts across {sectors_count} sectors, and it grows as new legislation is adopted. Every act's verification status is stated on the coverage page. The platform does not cover national implementing measures or guidance documents, and nothing on this site is legal advice.

files.ppwr: The packaging regulation's classifications are from a preliminary reading and have not yet been independently confirmed.

coverage_line.template: {acts_count} acts decoded so far; the platform grows as new legislation is adopted.

ego_notes._comment: One note per register file whose measures name and reach no sector at all. A note is REQUIRED for such a file: build_ego_views.py fails rather than composing one, because the sentence has to say what a missing sector ring means, and only a person can decide that. Slot {measure_count} is the file's own measure count, computed by the builder.

files.omnibus: None of the omnibus's {measure_count} measures names a specific sector. The act applies horizontally, to companies across the whole economy based on size and activity. Zero named sectors means no sector-specific provisions, not zero impact.
